_comment: Example of ~/.xencode/config.json (or $XCODE_CONFIG_DIR/config.json). Copy it there, or set individual keys with `xencode config set <KEY> <VALUE>`. Only the keys below exist — unknown keys are ignored by the loader. Cloud providers are selected by model prefix: `qwen:...`, `google_gemini:...`, or an OpenRouter-style `vendor/model` id; the local model is `default_model`. `agent_fallback_models` is tried in order by the agent, only while nothing has streamed yet; a `vendor/model` entry needs `openrouter_api_key`.
